WSIB Care Programs

Workplace injuries can disrupt daily life, affect mobility, and limit the ability to work comfortably and safely. That’s where WSIB Care Programs come in, providing comprehensive rehabilitation services, including physiotherapy, to help injured workers regain strength, restore function, and return to work safely.

At Tonic Physio, we understand the unique demands of workplace injury recovery. Our experienced team offers WSIB physiotherapy in Milton customized to each worker’s specific condition and job requirements. Through personalized treatment plans incorporating manual therapy, therapeutic exercise, and pain management strategies, we work to restore movement, reduce discomfort, and prevent long-term complications.

If you’re searching for WSIB physiotherapy near me, Tonic Physio is your trusted choice for evidence-based, compassionate care that focuses on long-term recovery and well-being.

Feel Better. Move Better. Live Fully. Trusted care that helps you move better and feel better. Call or book online now. Book Appointment Now Tonic Physio

Programs Offered at Tonic Physio

The Musculoskeletal Program of Care (MSK POC) is designed to address workplace injuries affecting muscles, joints, ligaments, and tendons. Common conditions include sprains, strains, back pain, and repetitive strain injuries. This program combines:

  • Manual therapy
  • Targeted exercise rehabilitation
  • Postural retraining
  • Pain management strategies

Our physiotherapists create individualized recovery plans that help improve strength, flexibility, and mobility, all essential for safely returning to work.

Mild Traumatic Brain Injury (mTBI) Program of Care

For workers recovering from concussions and other mild head injuries, the mTBI Program of Care offers specialized treatment customized to cognitive and physical rehabilitation. Key components include:

  • Structured neurological assessments
  • Gradual, supervised return-to-work planning
  • Balance, coordination, and cognitive retraining
  • Pain and stress management techniques

This program ensures workers recover safely and thoroughly before resuming their job duties.

Why Choose Tonic Physio for WSIB Physiotherapy in Milton?

Tonic Physio has been a trusted provider of WSIB physiotherapy services in Milton for over 25 years. Our clinic has built a reputation for delivering high-quality, compassionate, and results-driven rehabilitation care.

We maintain strong communication with WSIB case managers and healthcare providers to ensure seamless reporting, timely treatment updates, and collaborative care plans that prioritize your recovery and job readiness.

If you're seeking WSIB physiotherapy near me, Tonic Physio offers the experience, resources, and patient-first approach you deserve.

  • Physiotherapy
  • Registered Massage Therapy
  • Manual Osteopathy
  • Custom Orthotics
  • Compression Socks
  • Custom and OTC Bracing
  • Shockwave Therapy​
  • Motor Vehicle Accident Physiotherapy
  • WSIB Care Programs
